implementation: project P1 automatic-curvature path adapted to the Basilisk dynamic droplet case
method: axisymmetric centered Navier-Stokes; standard VOF; tension.h automatic curvature; CSF correction for spatially varying normal and tangential surface-tension stress
not_same_as_reference: does not use the official two-phase CLSVOF plus integral.h formulation
qcc_path: pinned Basilisk v2026-07-20 source snapshot; see ../p1b_official/p1b_source_manifest.json
decision: not accepted: speed error rises to about 10 percent on finer grids and does not converge to the theoretical migration speed
